title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Fee Calculation Note: The Late Charge on an Installment
content:
**Calculation.** The late charge on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans installment is the product's late-charge percentage of the unpaid part of that installment, the unpaid part being the installment due less the interest and principal payments applied to that installment bill, with the most recent interest payment and the most recent principal payment on that bill added back when the member's bank returned them, all as they stand on the day the charge is booked, and the installment due being the level installment on the loan record on that day or, for the final installment, its billed interest plus all principal then outstanding. The charge is figured once and rounded to cents, and the rounded charge may not be less than the product's minimum late charge or more than the product's maximum late charge.

## The quantities, defined

| Quantity | What it is, on the day the charge is booked |
|---|---|
| Installment due | the level installment amount on the loan record; for the final installment, its billed interest plus all principal then outstanding |
| Payments applied to the bill | the interest payments and the scheduled principal payments that point to that installment bill |
| Returned payments added back | when the member's bank returned the most recent interest payment or the most recent principal payment on that bill, the returned amount is added back to what remains unpaid |
| Unpaid part | the installment due less the payments applied to the bill, with any such returned payment added back |
| Late charge | the late-charge percentage of the unpaid part, rounded to cents, then held between the minimum and maximum late charge |

The late-charge percentage, the minimum late charge and the maximum late charge are the product's own figures in its servicing charges schedule.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

**A partly paid installment.** A Used Equipment Loan (late-charge percentage 5, minimum 25.00, maximum 500.00) has a level installment of 2400.00. An interest payment of 600.00 and a principal payment of 600.00 were applied to the bill, and the bank later returned the principal payment. The payments applied total 1200.00, the returned 600.00 is added back, and the unpaid part is 1800.00. Five percent of 1800.00 is 90.00, which lies between 25.00 and 500.00: the late charge is 90.00.

**The minimum governs.** On the same product, an unpaid part of 300.00 gives 15.00, below the minimum: the late charge is 25.00.

**The maximum governs.** On a Truck & Trailer Loan (5 percent, maximum 150.00), an unpaid part of 4000.00 gives 200.00, above the maximum: the late charge is 150.00.

**The final installment.** For a final installment billed with 180.00 of interest when 9000.00 of principal is outstanding, the installment due is 9180.00, not the level installment amount.

## Points of judgement

- The figures are read as they stand on the booking day, including any return the bank has made by then.
- Rounding to cents happens once, on the charge as figured; the minimum and maximum are then applied to the rounded figure.
